categories.name: Imagem
categories.description: Ferramentas para imagens, formatos e conteúdos visuais.
categories.description_en: A focused Image Lab for compressing, resizing, converting, cropping, framing, comparing, combining, and preparing visual content in your browser.

categories.name: PDF
categories.description: Ferramentas para criar, converter, organizar e trabalhar com documentos PDF.
categories.description_en: A focused PDF Lab for creating, converting, editing, organizing, and exporting documents in your browser.

tools.name: Compressor de Imagem
tools.description: Comprima JPG, PNG e WebP online gratuitamente. Reduza o tamanho do ficheiro, ajuste a qualidade e as dimensões e descarregue o resultado no navegador.
tools.description_en: Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images online for free. Reduce image file size, adjust quality and dimensions, and download the result in your browser.

tools.name: Redimensionador de Imagem
tools.description: Resize one or more images to exact pixel dimensions with aspect-ratio lock, contain, cover, stretch, quality, background, and local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Resize one or more images online for free to exact pixel dimensions with aspect-ratio lock, contain, cover, stretch, quality, background, and local browser processing.

tools.name: Conversor de Formato de Imagem
tools.description: Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF images in batches with optional resizing, quality control, rotation, flip, grayscale, and local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF images online for free in batches with optional resizing, quality control, rotation, flip, grayscale, and local browser processing.

tools.name: Cortador de Imagem
tools.description: Crop images to precise aspect ratios with drag positioning, rotation, flip, quality controls, and local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Crop images online for free to precise aspect ratios with drag positioning, rotation, flip, quality controls, and local browser processing.

tools.name: Marca-d'água de Imagem
tools.description: Create text watermarks with precise styling, positioning, rotation, repeat patterns, and local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Add text watermarks online for free with precise styling, positioning, rotation, repeat patterns, and local browser processing.

tools.name: Limpador de Metadados
tools.description: Re-encode one or more images locally to create fresh JPG, PNG, or WebP copies while comparing the original and cleaned outputs.
tools.description_en: Re-encode one or more images locally to create fresh JPG, PNG, or WebP copies while comparing the original and cleaned outputs.

tools.name: Extrator de Paleta de Cores
tools.description: Extract dominant colors from images with HEX, RGB, HSL, CSS, JSON, and gradient output using local browser analysis.
tools.description_en: Extract dominant image colors with HEX, RGB, HSL, CSS, JSON, and gradient output using local browser analysis.

tools.name: Redimensionador para Redes Sociais
tools.description: Create exact social-media image sizes with platform presets, cover or contain framing, optional text, and local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Create exact social-media image sizes with platform presets, cover or contain framing, optional text, and local browser processing.

tools.name: Gerador de Favicon e Ícones
tools.description: Generate favicon.ico, browser PNGs, Apple Touch Icon, and PWA icons from one image with local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Generate favicon.ico, browser PNGs, Apple Touch Icon, and PWA icons from one image with local browser processing.

tools.name: JPG → PDF
tools.description: Converta uma ou várias imagens JPG/JPEG em um único PDF, com tamanho de página, margens, orientação e qualidade ajustáveis.
tools.description_en: Convert multiple JPG/JPEG images into one PDF with reordering, page-size, orientation, margins, JPEG quality, camera input, and local export.

tools.name: PDF → JPG
tools.description: Converta páginas de um PDF em imagens JPG, escolhendo páginas, resolução e qualidade.
tools.description_en: Convert PDF pages to JPG locally with page selection, live preview, rendering resolution, JPG quality, progress, and downloadable results.

tools.name: PDF → PNG
tools.description: Converta páginas de um PDF em imagens PNG com resolução ajustável.
tools.description_en: Convert PDF pages to PNG locally with page selection, live preview, rendering resolution, progress, and downloadable results.

tools.name: PNG → PDF
tools.description: Converta uma ou várias imagens PNG em um único PDF com página, margem, orientação e ajuste configuráveis.
tools.description_en: Convert PNG images to PDF locally with multi-image upload, page sizing, orientation, fit modes, margins, quality, progress, and downloadable output.

tools.name: Juntar PDF
tools.description: Combine vários ficheiros PDF num único documento, organize a ordem e faça tudo localmente no navegador.
tools.description_en: Merge multiple PDF files locally with ordering controls, progress, page counts, downloadable output, and no artificial quotas.

tools.name: Dividir PDF
tools.description: Divida um PDF em vários ficheiros por páginas, com seleção por páginas ou intervalo.
tools.description_en: Split a PDF online for free into one-page files or selected page ranges and download the resulting documents.

tools.name: Rodar PDF
tools.description: Rode todas as páginas de um PDF ou apenas um intervalo e exporte o documento ajustado.
tools.description_en: Rotate PDF pages online for free by 90, 180, or 270 degrees and export a corrected PDF.

tools.name: Inserir Páginas
tools.description: Insira páginas de outro PDF no documento principal e exporte o resultado diretamente no navegador.
tools.description_en: Insert pages from another PDF into a main document online for free and export a new PDF.

tools.name: Duplicar Páginas
tools.description: Crie cópias de páginas dentro de um PDF, escolha páginas específicas, repetições e exporte um novo documento no navegador.
tools.description_en: Duplicate selected pages inside a PDF online for free, choose repetitions, and export a new document.

tools.name: Eliminar Páginas
tools.description: Remova páginas específicas de um PDF e exporte o documento limpo diretamente no navegador.
tools.description_en: Delete specific pages or page ranges from a PDF online for free and export a clean document.

tools.name: Marca-d’água no PDF
tools.description: Adicione uma marca-d’água de texto a todas as páginas de um PDF, com posição, tamanho, cor, opacidade e rotação ajustáveis.
tools.description_en: Add a text watermark to PDF pages online for free with position, size, color, opacity, and rotation controls.

tools.name: Juntar Imagens
tools.description: Combine multiple images into vertical, horizontal, or grid compositions with reordering, spacing, margins, background, and full-resolution export.
tools.description_en: Combine multiple images into vertical, horizontal, or grid compositions with reordering, spacing, margins, background, and full-resolution export.

tools.name: Desfocar & Pixelizar
tools.description: Desfoque ou pixelize imagens inteiras ou áreas selecionadas, com intensidade ajustável e processamento totalmente local.
tools.description_en: Blur or pixelate images online for free, including selected areas, adjustable intensity, live preview, and local browser export.

tools.name: Girar & Espelhar
tools.description: Gire imagens em passos de 90° e espelhe horizontal ou verticalmente, com pré-visualização imediata e exportação local.
tools.description_en: Rotate and flip images online for free with 90-degree controls, horizontal and vertical mirroring, live preview, and local full-resolution export.

tools.name: Adicionar Bordas
tools.description: Adicione molduras às imagens com espessura, cor, estilo, margem e cantos arredondados configuráveis.
tools.description_en: Add custom borders and frames to images with adjustable thickness, padding, color, style, rounded corners, shadow, and local full-resolution export.

tools.name: Antes e Depois
tools.description: Compare duas fotos com um divisor arrastável e exporte a comparação como uma única imagem.
tools.description_en: Compare two images with a draggable before-and-after slider, labels, fit controls, and local full-resolution export.

tools.name: Adicionar Texto ao PDF
tools.description: Adicione texto sobre páginas de um PDF, com posição, tamanho, cor e rotação ajustáveis.
tools.description_en: Add text to one or all PDF pages with precise position, size, color, rotation, opacity, and local export.
